definitions.explanation: The reference interest rate used as a baseline for setting the rates on loans, mortgages, and other financial products. A bank's advertised loan rate is typically expressed as 'the benchmark rate plus/minus X percentage points'.

examples.japanese: {基準金利|きじゅんきんり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The benchmark interest rate has risen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦ローン→ローン：06579_roon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{基準金利|きじゅんきんり}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: Mortgage rates are determined by the benchmark interest rate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日銀|にちぎん}→日銀：19311_nichigin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}した→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{基準金利|きじゅんきんり}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}された→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
examples.english: Because the Bank of Japan changed its policy, each bank's benchmark interest rate was also revised.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優良|ゆうりょう}→優良：30330_yuuryou⟧⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{基準金利|きじゅんきんり}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{一定|いってい}→一定：01735_ittei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{適用|てきよう}して→適用する：21739_tekiyousuru⟧⟦{融資|ゆうし}→融資：04775_yuushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: For top-rated customers, loans are offered at a set discount below the benchmark interest rate.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧ (standard, basis) and ⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧ (interest rate). A financial term referring to the reference rate that banks and other lenders publish and use as the baseline for pricing their loan products.

USAGE:
The headline rate that banks display for mortgages and business loans is typically the {基準金利|きじゅんきんり}; the rate a customer actually pays is that rate adjusted by a discount (⟦{優遇|ゆうぐう}→優遇：17162_yuuguu⟧) based on creditworthiness and the type of loan. Changes in this rate ripple through to mortgages, consumer loans, and corporate borrowing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {基準金利|きじゅんきんり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧ / ⟦{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げる→引き下げる：06193_hikisageru⟧: to raise / lower the benchmark interest rate
- {基準金利|きじゅんきんり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}する→上昇する：21681_joushousuru⟧ / ⟦{下落|げらく}→下落：11321_geraku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the benchmark rate rises / falls
- {基準金利|きじゅんきんり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連動|れんどう}→連動：14421_rendou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be linked to the benchmark interest rate
- ⟦{店頭|てんとう}→店頭：12488_tentou⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧: the posted (over-the-counter) rate, essentially the same as {基準金利|きじゅんきんり} for retail banking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{政策|せいさく}{金利|きんり}→政策金利：26656_seisakukinri⟧: policy interest rate — the rate set by the central bank (⟦{日銀|にちぎん}→日銀：19311_nichigin⟧), which drives the {基準金利|きじゅんきんり} of commercial banks
- ⟦{優遇|ゆうぐう}→優遇：17162_yuuguu⟧⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧: preferential interest rate — a discounted rate below the benchmark, offered to specific customers
- ⟦{適用|てきよう}→適用：03442_tekiyou⟧⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧: applied interest rate — the rate actually applied to a given loan, after any adjustments
- ⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧: market interest rate — the rate determined by financial markets, which influences the benchmark
